subject: Password reset for the HalvardCare portal

comments.author: Tom Ridley
comments.body: I'm locked out of the portal after too many failed logins. Can you reset it?

comments.author: Halvard Support
comments.body: Reset link sent to the account email on file. Let us know once you're back in.

comments.author: Halvard Support
comments.body: That worked, thanks — closing this out.
